messages:
carol: quick design note 62 screenshot attached 12 the left sidebar is pushing content and on narrow phones it eats ~40% width. thinking: switch to an overlay drawer on <=480px or keep a persistent mini mode with icons only. preferences?

asher: overlay drawer feels lighter on mobile. mini-icon mode ok for tablets but on phones icons only are ambiguous without labels. long-press tooltip could help but is not great for discoverability.

bea: agree overlay for phones. if we do mini for >=600px, ensure the collapse toggle has `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` and visible focus styles. also add an explicit "Show labels" toggle in settings for power users.

jesse: table issue: when sidebar is visible the right action column gets pushed out and users have to horizontally scroll. proposal: introduce column priority metadata so low-priority cols collapse into a stacked summary for small widths. Eg: keep name + status, collapse tokens/cost into details.

carol: nice. copy nit: change "Settings" to "Workspace" on mobile topbar so it feels less modal-y.

a11y-bot: automated scan: contrast of collapsed mini icon on dark mode is 3.2:1 (needs 4.5:1). also flagged missing `aria-expanded` on sidebar toggle in prototype. checklist: [ ] contrast >=4.5, [ ] aria-expanded, [ ] 48px touch targets, [ ] focus visible.

asher: CSS breakpoint suggestion: `@media (max-width:480px){ .sidebar{position:fixed; transform:translateX(-100%);} .sidebar.open{transform:translateX(0);} }` will mock this. also add `:focus-visible` outlines.

bea: accessibility flow: when drawer opens, focus should move to first focusable in drawer, esc closes and returns focus to toggle. keyboard nav order must not skip main content.

jesse: dev note: we'll add a `data-priority` attribute on columns and collapse algorithm that moves `data-priority="low"` into a details row. will test in landscape phone widths ~640x360.

carol: decision for now: overlay drawer under 480px, persistent mini at >=480 & <768 with labels toggled, column-priority collapse for tables. action owners: asher -> prototype overlay, jesse -> table collapse logic, bea+neal (adding neal to pairing) -> a11y checklist. i'll update figma and post link.
